claimBoundary: This source-generated geometry matrix is a package-only falsifier for the pinned libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0 private jmemmgr model on the current arm64 SIMD build. It is not a production backend qualification or cross-architecture memory promise.

The tested widths deliberately straddle h2v2 fancy-context activation at width 5, 64-byte alloc_sarray row-alignment boundaries, common 1920-wide media, and larger 8192-wide media. Height 129 keeps progressive coefficient arrays nontrivial while the pre-realize row-workspace mechanism remains width/sampling driven.

Expected allocSArray request shapes come from the JPEG sampling geometry model. Expected large-pool growth comes from the pinned source rules: rows are rounded to 2*ALIGN_SIZE, each large allocation is rounded to ALIGN_SIZE, and each chunk pays one large_pool_hdr plus ALIGN_SIZE-1. The capture must also prove that small/control allocations add zero pool growth for this qualified standard-component matrix; if that ceases to hold, the model fails rather than absorbing the delta into a fitted constant.
All generated JPEGs must remain progressive, decode without warnings, and the suspending probe final RGB must exactly match one-shot djpeg for the same pinned installation.
